instruction:
Task: In the 'Add/Modify Product Feature' form, click an 'Add Release Candidate' button to dynamically add input fields for a new release candidate, then fill in its details.
Expected Result: A new set of input fields for a release candidate (description, ID, date, status) appears within the feature form, allowing the user to define an additional release candidate for the feature being created or edited.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: A new set of input fields for a release candidate (description, ID, date, status) appears within the feature form, allowing the user to define an additional release candidate for the feature being created or edited.
